description: NaV₃O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.80 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.98 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-2.45 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
